description: This file is a Python script for a plugin skeleton generator, involving user prompts, YAML configuration loading, header file parsing, and interface selection logic.

methods.name: loadYAML
methods.description: Loads and parses a YAML configuration file, with error handling for file existence and parsing errors.

methods.name: validatePaths
methods.description: Checks that all provided header file paths exist, printing errors and exiting if not.

methods.name: collectList
methods.description: Collects multiple string entries from user input until an empty line is entered.

methods.name: prompts
methods.description: Interacts with the user to gather plugin configuration details and interface header paths.

methods.name: parserInterfaces
methods.description: Parses header files to extract interface class data and header lookup information.

methods.name: displayParsedData
methods.description: Displays parsed interface data in a formatted manner.

methods.name: _root
methods.description: Extracts the root name from a fully qualified interface name.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Main function that handles argument parsing, configuration loading, interface selection, and initiates code generation.
